title: Which company will hold the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign firm as of July 10, 2026?
background: Alibaba's 2014 US initial public offering raised $25 billion, setting the record for the largest US IPO by a foreign company.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official issuer announcements and contemporaneous reporting by reputable news organizations. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the company reported as holding the all-time record for the largest US initial public offering by a foreign company as of July 10, 2026. Compare offerings by proceeds raised, not company valuation. An offering whose pricing and share sales have been announced may qualify before exchange trading begins. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The company's commonly used name.
